messages:
Maya: Quick brainstorm 10am PT May 27 for a webinar: "Deploying inference at scale: decision patterns, benchmarks, and go-to-production checklists". Aim: ML/platform engineers + product managers. Need abstract, speakers, rehearsal plan, and lead routing plan.

Ethan: Love it. I can run ops (HubSpot, Zoom, tracking). Quick ask: do we want to gate registration by company size for later sales follow-up?

Priya: Id like to highlight three migration paths: start with Hosted -> Dedicated when throughput grows -> Private for compliance. Will craft a narrative with migration triggers and checklists.

Noah: I can demo two short benchmarks: single-request latency (p50/p99) and batch throughput with and without KV cache. Plan to record short clips and surface a small table with cost-per-1M tokens for each config. Prefers prerecorded + short live console.

Zoe: I can coordinate a customer panel with 2 customers: one PLG startup (early scale story) and an enterprise (Private deployment). Will confirm availability and ask for 4-5 minute snippets. Legal to review.

Maya: Proposed date May 27 at 10am PT. Goals: 350 registrants, 120 live, 25 MQLs routed. Which speakers can make those rehearsal windows?

Priya: May 27 works. Ill write the landing copy & abstract.

Noah: Works for me. Will prepare bench clips by May 12.

Zoe: Ill confirm customers by May 9 and request clips by May 15.

Ethan: Ops timeline: HubSpot form up by May 18, landing page + social creative by May 20. Ill set up lead routing: big-enterprise (company_size>250) -> AE team; startups -> Inbound SDR queue. Add UTMs: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email_social&utm_campaign=deploy_patterns.

Maya: Great. Please also ensure GA events for registration, attend, and on-demand views.

Priya: Draft abstract: "Teams shipping LLM features face repeated infrastructure choices as load, compliance, and cost evolve. Join Redwood product and runtime engineers for a practical migration playbook: when to stay on Hosted, when to reserve Dedicated capacity, and when to move to Private deployments. Includes benchmark comparisons, a customer panel, and a production checklist to guide your next deployment decision."

Maya: Can you sketch a 1-line elevator pitch and two short tweets-sized blurbs for LinkedIn?

Priya: Elevator: "A practical migration playbook for inference deployments1 Hosted, Dedicated, and Private0 what to choose and when." LinkedIn 1: "Register for our May 27 webinar: learn migration triggers from Hosted to Dedicated to Private, see benchmarks, and hear customer stories." LinkedIn 2: "Product + runtime engineers from Redwood show decision checklists, perf/cost tables, and real migration examples. Sign up -> [link]"

Noah: Demo plan (rough): record two 3-minute clips: 1) p50/p99 latency comparison across Hosted/Dedicated/Private; 2) batching + caching throughput showing cost delta. Will include SRT captions and a short speaker script. Live fallback: quick console tour showing traffic routing policy.

Zoe: Customer panel plan: two 4-5 minute clips interleaved after the second demo clip. Each customer answers 3 prompts: why they migrated, impact on SLAs/cost, and operational lessons. Ill supply interviewer prompts.

Ethan: Run-of-show draft:
00:00-03:00  Maya: Welcome, goals, TLDR
03:00-15:00  Priya: Migration playbook + checklist
15:00-25:00  Noah: Recorded benchmarks (clip 1 + clip 2)
25:00-35:00  Customer clips + short live reaction from panelists
35:00-50:00  Live Q&A and routing (all)
50:00-55:00  Closing, CTAs, resource links

Maya: Keep to 55 minutes. We should surface 3 CTAs: product tour, dedicated capacity eval, and private deployment contact form. Also collect a 1-line primary reason from registrants (checkbox options) so SDRs can prioritize.

Ethan: Good idea. HubSpot form: include checkbox for reason: cost, latency, compliance, scale, other. Route leads with reason=Compliance to Enterprise AE. Also tag leads with UTM.

Priya: Slides: max 14, with one decision matrix, one migration checklist, two demo snapshot slides, and customer quotes. Use MKTG/Slides/Templates.

Noah: Asset deadlines: bench clips by May 12, SRT transcript by May 13, slides to ops by May 20, final deck by May 22.

Zoe: Customer clips by May 15, legal sign-off by May 18. Ill provide interviewer guide and suggested timestamps.

Maya: Rehearsals: tech check May 22 (30m) + full run-through May 25 (60m). Please reserve both. Promo cadence: email blast 2 weeks out, 4 days out, 1 day out; social posts weekly until 2 weeks out then daily reminders.

Ethan: Ill schedule promo-bot to post social schedule and email send windows. Also will enable auto-sends for registrants who don't attend (on-demand).

Priya: Can attend both rehearsals.

Noah: Available for rehearsals and will join to handle live console.

Zoe: Available.

Maya: Action items summary:
- Priya: landing page copy, abstract, elevator + social blurbs (by May 20)
- Noah: bench clips + SRT (by May 12/13)
- Zoe: customer confirmations + clips + interviewer guide (by May 15)
- Ethan: HubSpot + lead routing + calendar invites + promo scheduling (HubSpot form by May 18)
- Maya: finalize run-of-show, CTAs, and QA checklist (by May 20)

Ethan: I'll set up HubSpot rules to route enterprise leads and tag the records. Also add GA event names: webinar_reg, webinar_attend, webinar_view_od.

Maya: Thanks team 680F4C8. We'll regroup after Priya posts copy.
